description: One call with the inputs for staking STANDARD into an S-Bill on The Standard Reserve (TSR), on Robinhood Chain. Returns the rate a deposit of this size would lock now, the premium, the caps checked against the wallet, the exit fee if you left right after depositing, and how the rate would move over 1h, 6h and 24h if nobody else deposits. That projection is derived, and the response states its assumption; the current rate, drift and ceiling it starts from are measured from the contract. The term length comes from the chain. Each part comes back under parts.<name> with its own status (ok, not_ready, or error); one part failing never fails the whole call. Requires amount. It returns inputs only and does not recommend an action.

amount.description: Whole STANDARD tokens to stake, as a positive decimal string (not wei), up to 18 decimal places.

wallet.description: Optional 0x wallet address. Adds its open S-Bills principal and its headroom under the per-wallet cap.
